newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Q1 fishmeal output falls 19.3 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Q1 fishmeal output falls 19.3 percent.

text.p: Peru produced 302,200 tonnes of fishmeal in the first quarter, 19.3 percent down from 374,500 tonnes in the same period last year, preliminary figures released by the Fisheries Ministry showed Thursday.
Exports of fishmeal in the first three months, however, grew 28.9 percent to 573,300 tonnes from 444,600 tonnes in the same period last year.
Fishmeal, Peru's most important fishing product, accounted for 74 percent of the country's total processing of 411,100 tonnes of fish and other sea products in the first quarter.
Production of Peru's second most important fish product, raw fish oil, was 55,200 tonnes in the period, down 10.7 percent from 61,800 tonnes last year.
The total catch of Peruvian fish and sea species between January and March was down 19.2 percent to 1.59 million tonnes from 1.97 million in the first quarter of 1996.
Peru produced 1.885 million tonnes of fishmeal in 1996, up 5.4 percent from 1995. Last year's exports of fishmeal, however, fell 14 percent to 1.529 million tonnes.
